scope: Native fixed-namespace Keychain helper and build/test-domain separation
Versioned Mac envelopes, unchanged Windows DPAPI, typed failure propagation and no plaintext fallback
Credential APIs, portable recovery, bot persistence/list concurrency and frontend recovery
Disposable Keychain fixtures and existing test changes

findings.finding: New permanent bot decryption causes were absent from the existing full-replacement UI
findings.resolution: Added key_missing/key_changed/provider_mismatch to explicit recovery; existing UI journey covers old decrypt_failed and a new key_missing case

findings.finding: A damaged global wrapping key cannot be repaired by re-entering bot secrets or changing the data directory
findings.resolution: Removed keychain_corrupt from full-replacement causes; startup/UI require system Keychain recovery or a separate healthy OS account/machine

findings.finding: Promise.all over up to 16 bot credential owners exceeds the four-helper process limit during a normal list request
findings.resolution: Both list call sites reuse serial externalBotPublicConnections; the real Mac Keychain e2e checks five healthy local connections

independentValidation.dpapiPreservation: functionBlock comparison: runDpapi body identical to original run
independentValidation.finalReview: no unresolved executable findings; no unnecessary production framework or redundant test files

testDiscipline: One new Mac e2e, shared disposable fixture reused by the original discovery HTTP test; no new unit test file; existing Windows mock assertions retained.
unverified: Production login Keychain authorization and real OS user-denial recovery
Formal signing identity / helper upgrade ACL stability (P4/P6)
Windows same-SHA runtime, minimum macOS 14, clean offline distribution
evidenceBoundary: Real isolated Keychain lock/unlock/missing/damaged/key-material change are exercised. Permission denial/requirement uses fake IPC responses; replace-key does not prove signing identity migration. Reviewer ran no concurrent e2e and accessed no login Keychain.
documentationClarification: Preview does not write application config/vault or imported credentials; first use may initialize a random system wrapping key.
